positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.description: As part of the new graduate rotational program, I spent 2 years working in 3 different roles across the organization: Project Manager, Test Engineer, Software Engineer. Drove impact in each role, as well as via engagement with Employee Resource Groups and Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives.

positions.title: Activities and Orientation Assistant
positions.description: Planned and executed first-year orientation, with a focus on connecting the student body during the ongoing pandemic. Supervised orientation leaders by providing training and guidance.

positions.title: Freshman Year Advisor
positions.description: Provided support (transitional, academic, emotional, etc.) to a first-year student cohort

positions.title: Data Analysis Intern
positions.description: Supported data migration by reconfiguring business data reports and queries to utilize new cloud data warehouses. Investigated equity market trends by analyzing NCSS clearing data, contributing to the ongoing development of a new business product.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Enhanced Enterprise Application Support (EAS) operations by developing an application health monitoring system that automates procedures previously performed manually. Collaborated with a team of 12 interns through 3 scrum sprints, with the mentorship of an experienced agile team.

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst Intern
positions.description: Updated requirement documentation of insurance applications. Worked closely with product owners and development team to analyze gaps in application functionality.

positions.title: Program Assistant
positions.description: Supervised the facilitation of engineering design challenges and computer science programs, engaging with 500-1000 visitors daily. Assisted in the development and prototyping of new exhibits.
